'''Vorknkx Project Base''' was the primary research base for the [[Vorknkx Project|project of the same name]]. It was where the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvette]], ''[[Vorknkx]]'' was housed.

==History==
The Vorknkx Project Base' was the primary research station for the [[Vorknkx Project|project of the same name]]. It consisted of two [[XQ5 Platform]]s [[V1]] and [[V2]] and a number of Probes that would record data during demonstrations. The ultimate goal of the project was to produce a [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]] that would be small enough to make Imperial [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] invisible. The liklihood of success was low, but it was a gamble worth trying should a breakthrough be achieved. Due to the far reaching consequences of such progress, only [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin|Zaarin]] and the project staff acknowledged its existence.

When Zaarin betrayed Palpatine and began his [[Zaarin insurrection|insurrection]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], he sought whatever technological advantage he could muster and the Vorknkx project was one of those he sought out. He sent the [[Nebulon-B2 frigate]] [[Z-Borus]] to [[Attack on Vorknkx Project Base|capture]] the base. The attack was driven of by [[Tan (title)|Tan]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] in a [[Missile Boat]] but the site was compromised and therefore the base was [[Evacuation of Vorknkx Project Base|evacuated]] while under attack again by Zaarin's forces. The testbed and the staff were relocated to [[To-phalion Base]] an exhausted [[Asteroid/Legends|Asteroid]] [[Asteroid Hangar|facility]] where the project could continue until Zaarin [[Battle of To-phalion Base|stole]] the testbed from the base.
